answer: Challenge-chain blocks bulk fakes: each identity opens one hash chain at one inlet, onyx-sealed to its key. Each epoch adds a link; its delta from the last must match the public seed rule. A forked or fake link breaks the delta and burns a 70-credit bond. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 10,000 in fees against a 40,000 pool, losing 40,000. Rented chains fail: the onyx seal is the lender's. An honest agent pays 10 an epoch and keeps bond and share.
